title: Trikala: Script of God
plot_overview: Trikala: Script of God follows a heroic journey tied to ancient mysteries from Indian Sanatana Dharma. When darkness falls, a powerful light emerges to guide the world, with Trikala standing as one of the Illuminator.
will_you_like_this: You’ll likely enjoy Trikala: Script of God if you want a mythic, heroic story about light versus darkness rooted in Sanatana Dharma; Not for you if you prefer grounded, clearly defined conflicts and detailed explanations.
review_summary: Pros: inspiring mythic premise; uplifting heroism; mysterious lore | Cons: limited plot specifics; may feel abstract
